title: Generate Run Script
text: Generate FlightGear run script on current platform, {Select FlightGear data flow} sets FlightGear data flow; {Select target architecture} sets the target platform to run, {FlightGear geometry model name} sets the folder containing FlightGear, {Airport ID} sets the iD of supported, {Runway ID} sets the iD of supported, {Initial altitude (ft)*} sets the initial aircraft altitude, {Initial heading (deg)*} sets the initial aircraft heading, {Offset distance (miles)*}, {Offset azimuth (deg)*} sets the aircraft offset azimuth, {Install FlightGear scenery during simulation (requires Internet connection)}, {Disable FlightGear shader options}, {Destination/Origin IP address} sets the network IP address of machine running MATLAB, {Destination port}, {Origin port}, {Network IP address}, {Output file name} sets the output file runfg.bat, {FlightGear base directory} and {Generate Script}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Select target architecture
params.values: Target platform to run script Default (default) | Win64 | Linux | Mac

params.name: Select FlightGear data flow
params.values: FlightGear data flow Send (default) | Receive | Send-Receive

params.name: Install FlightGear scenery during simulation (requires Internet connection)
Destination/Origin IP address
params.values: Network IP address of machine running MATLAB 127.0.0.1

params.name: Network IP address
params.values: Network IP address of FlightGear machine 127.0.0.1
